text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes—the race that will decide the junior champion.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can only imagine how thrilled Grandfather would be to see me here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: When I was young, I could not control my impulses and would even try to subjugate others through force.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I mistook violence for strength, but my grandfather set me on the right path before I had a chance to stray too far.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Do not let those flames of yours burn you. You must tame them and become their master.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: He was strict, stubborn, and annoying. But he was equally kind, persevering, and warm. And he never shied away from me either.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Grampa… You were the one who taught me how to control my heart by leading me down the path of a warrior.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And when that alone did not quell the fire within me, you showed me the way of the racer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You gifted me the path that I now live by, and that makes my heart dance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To pay back your kindness and to usher on my growth, I shall now push forward on a new journey.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must ascertain which Umamusume will be a worthy rival to walk down this path with.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh… I guess Ardan couldn't make it after all, huh…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… A few days ago she said that she'd come to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But her doctor won't let her, so she's resting at home today…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan is an incredible racer! As a member of the prestigious Mejiro family, she's bursting with skill and talent!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, her body is quite weak…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Not every bud is meant to flower, I suppose…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-that's why I have to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Everyone is improving, including me, and the secret to growing strong is to race! In other words, "static can't shock you if you have gloves on"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Today is the Asahi Hai F.S., and I have to win it no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen won this race, after all. Plus…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well… I'm not the type to let anyone take my dream from me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, I know there are probably other racers who are just skilled as me, if not more… But well, um…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I will! I'm going to pour my whole heart into this race and bring the flower of victory to bloom!
